blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Cervical cytology presents a fundamentally ambiguous diagnostic landscape, where equivocal categories such as Atypical Squamous Cells of Undetermined Significance (ASC-US) occupy a morphological grey zone that is definitional. For clinical decision support, the goal extends beyond assigning a definitive label to every sample: cases must also be distinguished by whether the available evidence supports a confident decision or warrants further consideration, a distinction conventional classification models are not designed to explicitly represent. We propose a multiscale evidential framework that models cervical cytology along an ordinal disease continuum using clinically grounded soft anchors, representing progression from benign reactive changes to precancerous lesions and malignancy. Three biologically motivated spatial contexts--nuclear morphology, cytoplasmic characteristics, and neighbourhood cellular architecture--are independently encoded using a shared frozen DINOv2 backbone, preserving inter-scale disagreement that early fusion may obscure. Calibrated predictions are transformed into Dempster--Shafer belief masses and fused with reliability discounting, allowing conflicting evidence and insufficient support to remain explicitly uncommitted rather than forcing a decision. The fused belief state drives interpretable routing that separates confidently classified cases from those with irreducible evidential insufficiency, enabling clinically meaningful triage. Across two independent publicly available conventional cytology datasets, RIVA and CRIC Cervix, the framework generalises consistently, with uncertainty strongly associated with diagnostic difficulty: incorrect predictions carry 1.94x-4.13x higher uncertainty than correct ones.
blocks.zh: 子宫颈细胞学呈现出一个根本模糊不清的诊断地貌,其模棱两可的分类如非典型的分量细胞(ASC-US)占据着一个具有定义性的形态灰色区. 对于临床决策支持,目标超越了给每个样本指定一个明确的标签:病例还必须区分为现有证据是否支持一个自信的决定或是否值得进一步审议,区分常规分类模型的设计并不明确代表. 我们提出一个多尺度的证据框架,利用临床基础的软锚,将子宫颈细胞学模拟在平分疾病连续体上,代表从良性反应变化到先发性损伤和恶性。 三个具有生物动力的空间环境 -- -- 核形态、细胞质特征和相邻的细胞结构 -- -- 使用一个共享的被冻结的DINOv2主干线进行独立编码,保留了早期聚变可能模糊的大规模分歧。 校正后的预测被转化为"德姆斯特-Shafer"信仰团并被与可靠性折价结合,允许相冲突的证据和不充分的支持保持明确不承诺,而不是强迫决定. 连接的信念状态驱动可解释的路径,将有自信地分类的病例与那些有不可减少的证据不足的病例区分开来,从而得以在临床上有意义的分解. 在两个独立的可公开获取的常规细胞数据集,即RIVA和审评委Cervix中,框架的通用性一致,不确定性与诊断困难密切相关:不正确的预测比正确预测的不确定性高1.94x-4.13x。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Cervical cancer is among the most prevalent yet preventable cancers
worldwide, with the Pap smear serving as a primary screening modality [ 1 ] .
Cytological findings are reported according to The Bethesda System (TBS),
the internationally adopted standard updated in 2014, from which eight
diagnostic categories are considered in this work [ 18 , 19 ] (Table 1 ). Importantly, these categories are not equally
definitive: TBS distinguishes definitive interpretations (NILM, ENDO, INFL LSIL, HSIL, SCC) from equivocal grey-zone categories (ASC-US, ASC-H). This
distinction reflects the fact that some cellular morphologies cannot be
reliably separated at the single-cell level.

blocks.en:
This structure also reflects an underlying ordinal progression in
clinical severity. Persistent high-risk HPV infection can drive
progressive cellular changes, with TBS categories occupying different
positions along this trajectory and carrying different clinical risks.
In particular, the risk of CIN3+ – a surrogate measure of high-grade cervical disease and cancer risk, increases substantially across the spectrum, from near-zero for NILM to 60–100% for HSIL, with ASC-US and LSIL occupying intermediate positions [ 8 ] . Thus, the categories are clinically ordered rather than a collection of independent labels. At the same time, important category boundaries remain morphologically ambiguous:
INFL and ASC-US can exhibit overlapping nuclear features, while ENDO
cells are benign but can exhibit morphology that mimics HSIL [ 19 ] . These cases illustrate why a visually plausible
prediction is not necessarily a definitive one.

blocks.en:
Cytopathologists address such ambiguity by integrating evidence across
spatial scales, from cellular grouping and neighbourhood context at
lower magnification to nuclear chromatin and membrane detail at higher
magnification [ 1 ] . For automated analysis, this creates
three coupled challenges: distinguishing visually similar categories
whose relationships are ordinal rather than independent [ 3 , 26 ] ;
handling genuinely ambiguous class boundaries; and combining
complementary evidence observed at different spatial scales. A
classifier operating on an isolated nucleus patch therefore captures
only part of the available diagnostic evidence. Moreover, conventional
multiscale architectures typically fuse features before prediction,
which can suppress disagreement between scales precisely when that
disagreement may indicate an ambiguous case. Hard categorical
predictions further provide no explicit representation of insufficient
or conflicting evidence.

blocks.en:
We propose a framework that treats these properties of cervical
cytology as design constraints rather than incidental characteristics.
Specifically, we introduce: (i) clinically grounded, non-uniform ordinal soft anchors that encode the NILM-to-SCC progression and provide a
structured representation of class relationships; (ii) three
spatially independent scale-specific MLPs operating on frozen DINOv2
features, allowing evidence from different spatial scales to remain
separable and preserving their disagreement for subsequent fusion; (iii) a Dempster–Shafer fusion stage that combines calibrated
scale-specific likelihoods into explicit belief masses
( m benign m_{\mathrm{benign}} , m lesion m_{\mathrm{lesion}} , and m uncertain m_{\mathrm{uncertain}} ), allowing evidentially insufficient cases to
be routed for further review rather than forcing a categorical
decision; and (iv) cross-dataset evaluation on RIVA [ 22 ] and CRIC Cervix [ 23 ] , showing that incorrect predictions
exhibit systematically greater uncertainty than correct predictions
and that cases assigned high uncertainty are concentrated around the
equivocal categories identified by TBS.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Deep learning approaches to cervical cytology have achieved competitive performance on isolated-cell benchmarks [ 6 , 14 , 16 , 7 ] ,
but studies differ substantially in diagnostic label groupings, dataset usage, and evaluation protocols, complicating direct comparison across reported results [ 17 , 4 ] . For RIVA, a recently introduced conventional-smear benchmark, the literature is still emerging, with the 2026 ISBI challenge establishing an eight-category detection-and-classification benchmark [ 11 , 15 , 12 ] . A systematic review of 77 studies similarly identifies limited generalizability and insufficient representation of real-world cytological complexity as persistent challenges [ 28 ] . Multiscale architectures have been explored to incorporate complementary morphological information across spatial contexts [ 14 , 16 ] , however these predictions are typically used to improve classification rather than to explicitly characterize the evidence provided by each spatial view.
blocks.zh:
宫颈细胞学的深层学习方法在隔离细胞基准上取得了竞争力[6、14、16、7],
但是,在诊断标签分类、数据集使用和评价协议方面,研究差异很大,使报告结果的直接比较复杂化[17,4]。 对于最近采用的常规烟雾基准,RIIVA的文献仍在出现,2026年ISBI的挑战确立了一个八类检测和分类基准[11、15、12]。 对77项研究的系统审查同样发现,现实世界细胞学复杂性的有限普遍性和代表性不足是持续存在的挑战[28]。 探索了多尺度结构,以纳入空间背景的补充形态信息[14,16],但这些预测通常用于改进分类,而不是明确描述每个空间视角提供的证据。

blocks.en:
Uncertainty-aware and evidential learning provides a framework for
representing predictions beyond a single categorical decision.
Evidential deep learning models uncertainty through learned evidence [ 24 ] , while Dempster–Shafer theory (DST) [ 25 , 5 ] represents support for competing hypotheses together with uncommitted evidence. Recent work has extended DS-based reasoning to reliable classification [ 13 ] , set-valued evidential prediction [ 2 ] , class inference [ 27 ] , and dynamic evidence learning [ 9 ] .
These developments establish DST as a general framework for reasoning with incomplete or conflicting evidence, but its use as an explicit fusion mechanism for complementary spatial predictions in cervical cytology remains unexplored.
blocks.zh:
不确定意识和证据学习为下列工作提供了框架:
代表着超越一个绝对决定的预测。
通过学到的证据进行深层次的学习模型不确定性[24],而Dempster–Shafer理论[25,5]则代表了对相互竞争的假设与未承诺的证据的支持. 最近的工作将基于DS的推理扩展到了可靠的分类[13],设定值证据预测[2],类推[27],动态证据学习[9].
这些发展将DST确立为以不完整或相互矛盾的证据进行推理的一般框架,但其作为子宫颈细胞学中互补空间预测的明确聚变机制的使用仍未被探讨.

blocks.en:
Our work brings these two directions together by treating the nuclear, cellular, and neighbourhood views of a cell as separate evidence sources. Rather than fusing their features or predictions into a single categorical decision, we retain their evidential states until late fusion, allowing agreement, conflict, and insufficient evidence to influence the final decision. We therefore use established DST machinery to formulate an ambiguity-aware multiscale classification and routing framework tailored
to cervical cytology.
blocks.zh:
我们的工作通过将细胞的核、细胞和邻里观点作为单独的证据来源,将这两个方向结合在一起。 我们没有把他们的特征或预测化为单一的绝对决定,而是保留他们的证据状态,直到晚聚变,允许达成协议,冲突,以及没有足够的证据影响最终决定。 因此,我们利用既定的DST机制,制定一种有模糊感的多尺度分类和路线框架,并量身定制
宫颈细胞学

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: The preceding sections identify three requirements for reliable cervical cytology classification: spatial contexts provide complementary morphological evidence, the Bethesda categories follow an ordinal continuum, and some cells remain equivocal even under multiscale examination. We therefore formulate the task as multiscale evidential inference, keeping predictions from different spatial views independent until evidence is explicitly combined.
blocks.zh: 前几节确定了可靠的宫颈细胞学分类的三项要求:空间背景提供补充形态学证据,贝塞斯达类遵循一个官阶连续体,一些细胞即使在进行多尺度检查时也依然模棱两可. 因此,我们把这项任务拟订为多尺度的证据推论,使不同空间观点的预测保持独立,直至证据明确合并。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of the proposed framework. Multiscale patches capturing nuclear, cytoplasmic, and neighbourhood context are processed through a shared frozen DINOv2 backbone and independent scale-specific heads. Calibrated predictions are transformed into Dempster–Shafer evidence and fused with reliability discounting to support explicit uncertainty for ambiguity-aware routing.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议框架概览。 捕获核、细胞质和邻里环境的多尺度补丁通过共享冻结的DINOv2主干线和独立的规模专用头处理。 校准的预测被转换成Dempster–Shafer证据,并结合了可靠性的折价,以支持对模糊感-知路由的明确不确定性.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , each annotated cell is represented using three nucleus-centred patches of 100, 200, and 400 pixels. The 100-pixel crop follows the cell annotation convention provided by RIVA; the 200- and 400-pixel crops were defined by us to progressively incorporate cytoplasmic and neighbourhood context. For CRIC Cervix, where cells are specified by nucleus coordinates, we apply the same multiscale cropping principle around the annotated cell. Thus, the same spatial hierarchy is maintained across both datasets.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,每个带注释的单元格都使用三个以核为中心的100、200和400像素的补丁来表示。 100像素作物遵循RIVA提供的细胞注解常规;200像素作物和400像素作物被我们定义为逐渐结合细胞质和邻里环境. 审评委 Cervix,在核坐标指定细胞的地方,我们在注释细胞周围应用同样的多尺度裁剪原理. 因此,两个数据集的空间等级保持不变。

blocks.en: Each crop is encoded by a shared frozen DINOv2 backbone, followed by an independent prediction head for each scale. The heads are trained using ordinal soft anchors for all eight Bethesda categories, producing a scalar lesion-transition score rather than a conventional eight-class probability vector. These scores are subsequently calibrated and interpreted within a binary benign–lesion evidential frame. Each scale therefore contributes evidence that can support either hypothesis or remain uncommitted. The three evidential sources are reliability-discounted and fused using Dempster–Shafer theory (DST), producing a belief state that is finally used to route the cell to an appropriate downstream action.
blocks.zh: 每个作物由一个共享的冷冻的DINOv2主干编码,然后是每个尺度的独立预测头. 头部使用所有8个贝塞斯达类的正弦软锚进行训练,生成一个鳞片损伤-过渡分数,而不是传统的8级概率矢量. 这些分数随后在一个二进制的良性证据框架内校准和解释。 因此,每个比额表都提供了可以支持假设或保持不承诺的证据。 这三个证据来源是使用Dempster-Shafer理论(DST)进行可靠性贴现和熔化,产生一种信念状态,最终用于引导细胞进行适当的下游动作.

blocks.en: 3.1 Multiscale Feature Extraction and Ordinal Prediction
blocks.zh: 3.1 多尺度地物提取和常规预测

blocks.en: For each annotated cell, we extract the three nucleus-centred patches described above. Each view is encoded independently using a shared frozen DINOv2 ViT-B/14 backbone [ 21 ] . DINOv2’s self-supervised pretraining on diverse visual data provides representations of texture, shape, and relational structure, reducing reliance on explicitly engineered cytological measurements such as segmentation-dependent N/C ratio or chromatin grading. The backbone is not finetuned to reduce overfitting to dataset-specific staining and acquisition characteristics, while the subsequent scale-specific heads learn the information associated with each spatial context.
blocks.zh: 对于每个注解的单元格,我们提取上述三个以核为中心的补丁. 每个视图都使用共享的冻结的DINOv2 VIT-B/14主干线独立编码[21]. DINOv2对多种视觉数据进行自我监督的预训,提供了纹理,形状和关系结构的表示,减少了对明确设计的细胞学测量的依赖,如分解依赖N/C比或铬定级. 骨干不进行微调,以减少过于适应数据集特有的污渍和获取特性,而后续的尺度特定头则学习与每个空间背景相关的信息.

blocks.en: A separate MLP prediction head is trained for each scale so that the three views retain independent predictions for subsequent evidential fusion. Standard binary supervision would assign all benign categories the same target and all lesion categories another, discarding the ordered progression between clinically distinct Bethesda categories. We instead retain all eight categories during supervision by assigning each class a scalar soft anchor y c ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] y_{c}\in[0,1] representing its ordinal position along the benign-to-malignancy continuum and keeping the equivocality of ASC-US and ASC-H intact.
blocks.zh: 每个尺度都培训一个单独的MLP预测头,这样这三个观点就保留了独立的预测,用于随后的证据聚变. 标准二进制监管将为所有良性类别指定同一目标类别和所有损伤类别,放弃临床上截然不同的贝塞斯达类别之间的有序进展。 相反,我们在监督期间保留了所有8个类别,为每个类别分配一个标定软锚和c ∈ [0,1] y cc}\in [0,1] ,代表其沿良性-伤害连续体的正统位置,并保持ASC-US和ASC-H的模棱两可。

blocks.en: Each MLP is trained with BCEWithLogitsLoss against its class-specific soft anchor, producing a continuous lesion-transition score whose value reflects the ordinal position of the TBS category rather than a hard benign–lesion label. The anchors are informed by the CIN3+ risk progression described by the ASCCP risk-based framework, but represent ordinal positions rather than raw clinical risk probabilities [ 8 ] . The binary evidential frame therefore interprets, rather than replaces, the learned ordinal prediction for final benign–lesion routing.
blocks.zh: MLP通过BCEWithLogitsLoss针对其特定班级的软锚进行训练,产生连续的损伤-过渡分数,其值反映TBS类的平面位置,而不是硬的良性标签。 锚点参考了ASCCP基于风险的框架所描述的CIN3+风险进展,但代表着平面位置而不是原始临床风险概率[8]. 因此,二进制证据框架解释而不是取代对最终良性-lesion路径学得的正统预测。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Clinically grounded, non-uniform ordinal soft anchors for the eight TBS categories. The ordering and relative spacing encode clinically motivated proximity along the benign-to-malignant continuum; anchor values are ordinal positions rather than raw clinical risk probabilities.
blocks.zh: 表2:8个TBS类别的临床固定、非统一、普通软锚。 定购和相对间隔在临床上将良性-恶性连续体的近似性编码;锚值是直线位置,而不是原始临床风险概率。

blocks.en: The non-uniform anchor spacing encodes clinically motivated proximity along the TBS continuum: benign categories occupy a compact region, while the larger transitions toward ASC-US and LSIL distinguish equivocal from definitive lesion states, and the closely spaced LSIL–ASC-H–HSIL–SCC categories reflect their related but progressively severe lesion spectrum [ 1 ] . In particular, the ASC-US anchor places this definitionally equivocal category between the benign and lesion regions without collapsing it into either, allowing the scalar output to retain graded ordinal information for subsequent evidential fusion.
blocks.zh: 非统一锚距编码是临床上驱动的TBS连续体的近距离:良性类占据了紧凑的区域,而向ASC-US和LSIL的较大过渡则区分了确定性损伤状态,而LSIL-ASC-H-H-HSIL-SCC的紧密间距则反映了它们相关但逐渐严重的损伤谱[1]。 特别是,ASC-US主锚将这一定义上的模糊类别置于良性和损伤性区域之间,而不将其分解为两者之一,从而可以使分级输出保留分级的普通信息,用于随后的证据聚变。

blocks.en: 3.2 Calibrated Predictions and Evidential Fusion
blocks.zh: 3.2 校准预测和证据组合

Although the MLP was trained using the eight ordinal targets, the evidential stage operates on the binary hypotheses Θ = { B , L } \Theta=\{B,L\} , where NILM, ENDO, and INFL form the benign group and ASC-US, LSIL, ASC-H, HSIL, and SCC form the lesion group. This binary frame is used only to express the routing evidence; the ordinal

blocks.en:
Because neural networks may produce poorly calibrated, systematically overconfident or underconfident probabilities, and these probabilities directly determine the amount of evidence assigned to each hypothesis, calibration is performed independently for each scale before evidence construction. We evaluate temperature scaling [ 10 ] and 5-fold cross-validated isotonic regression [ 20 , 29 ] , selecting the strategy for each dataset based on validation performance. A scale-specific decision threshold t s t_{s} is then selected on the validation set by maximizing binary macro-F1 over candidate thresholds

blocks.en: For CRIC Cervix, we additionally apply a dataset-specific NILM vote filter to the uncertain pool to suppress spurious lesion votes. Samples with fewer than two of three lesion votes are reassigned to the benign branch. This adjustment is not part of the core evidential formulation and is discussed in section 8 and the supplementary material.

blocks.en: The resulting framework is therefore a fixed evidential formulation rather than a collection of independently tuned components. The spatial scales and ordinal anchors establish the clinical formulation, with patch sizes dictated by the available annotation conventions, while evidential fusion and routing provide a consistent procedure for combining and interpreting the resulting predictions. Only calibration strategy and scale-specific decision thresholds are selected on validation data to account for dataset-specific differences in acquisition and class distribution. Once selected, all parameters remain fixed for test evaluation.
blocks.zh: 因此,由此产生的框架是一种固定的证据表述,而不是一套独立调制的组件。 空间尺度和正弦锚定在临床配方上,由现有的注解公约决定补丁大小,而证据聚变和路由则为综合和解释由此产生的预测提供了一致的程序。 在验证数据上只选择校准策略和标尺特定决定阈值,以核算获取和类分布中数据集特定差异. 一旦选定,所有参数仍固定用于测试评价。

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en:
RIVA. RIVA [ 22 ] is a large-scale conventional Pap smear dataset
covering all eight TBS categories, with cell annotations reviewed by up
to four cytopathologists. We use train/validation/test split of 10,613, 2,654, and 2,682 annotated cells, respectively. RIVA includes both INFL and ASC-US, providing a challenging benign–lesion boundary, as well as ENDO, a benign class whose morphology can resemble HSIL.

Different scanning and staining conditions and a distinct demographic
distribution from RIVA provide a cross-dataset test of generalization.
NILM constitutes 58.8% of the annotated cells, while ASC-US has only
91 validation and 91 test samples; its results should therefore be
interpreted with appropriate caution.

The conflict results are particularly relevant to the proposed
formulation: DST retains its advantage when spatial views provide
inconsistent evidence or insufficient evidence for a confident decision, rather than only when their predictions agree.

冲突结果与拟议
措辞: 当空间观点提供时,DST保持其优势
证据不一致或没有足够证据来作出有把握的决定,而不只是在他们的预测一致的情况下。

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 2 , existing results arise from heterogeneous experimental settings; a detailed comparative study is provided in the supplementary material. Hence, their results provide valuable context but not a controlled baseline for our setting. Our framework targets a different objective: uncertainty-aware benign–lesion triage with an explicit state for insufficient evidence, rather than direct multiclass classification. A controlled comparison requires fixing the representation, predictions, and task while varying only the fusion strategy, precisely what Table 5 provides by evaluating the same calibrated scale-specific predictions under our DST formulation against established late-fusion alternatives.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented a clinically grounded multiscale evidential framework for cervical cytology that combines nuclear, cellular, and neighbourhood evidence through calibrated Dempster–Shafer fusion. Across RIVA and CRIC Cervix, DST consistently improves over individual scales and alternative fusion strategies, with its strongest advantage occurring under inter-scale conflict. The fused evidence also preserves the ordinal progression of Bethesda categories, while incorrect predictions exhibit substantially higher uncertainty than correct predictions, particularly around ambiguous class boundaries. These results establish the value of explicitly representing inter-scale conflict and diagnostic ambiguity for more reliable cytology decisions and evidence-based routing.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个基于临床的宫颈细胞学的多尺度证据框架,通过校准的Dempster-Shafer聚变将核、细胞和邻里证据结合起来。 纵观《国际资源报告》和审评委《塞尔维克斯公约》,DST在单个规模和替代聚变战略方面不断改进,其最大优势出现在规模冲突期间。 被保险的证据也保留了贝塞斯达类的正向进展,而不正确的预测显示的不确定性大大高于正确的预测,特别是围绕模棱两可的类别界限。 这些成果确定了明确代表大规模冲突和诊断模糊性的价值,以便作出更可靠的细胞学决定和基于证据的路径。
